note: Fixes #259 (part of #190). The In flight reader ended its section at any line whose trimmed text started with '## ', so a heading GitHub hides (in an HTML comment, a code fence, a pre or div block, or indented code) cut the section and a later FAIL table was never read. New gate/MitosGate/Snapshot/Block.lean names the block GitHub starts at a line (blank, heading, hides, other, text), following list items into their text, with its statements beside it. Table.lean ends the section only at an ATX level-2 heading after at most 3 spaces, reads none for any section line that is not text or blank, reads none when a fence or HTML block opens above the In flight heading, counts only an In flight heading at the start of its line, and skips the PR header row and the delimiter row only as a pair under a blank line or the heading; anywhere else each is a data row without a PR number, so none. 27 new none fixtures each fail on the old Table.lean (kernel mismatch: the old reader returns some with the #7 PASS row, or adds #8); 4 new positive fixtures show that a real ## heading still ends the section (2 of them also differ on the old code: a tab after ## and a bare ##); 7 line-level statements in Block.lean. snapshot-test.sh gains the P1 comment case and its fence twin: the fix holds every pull request and pushes nothing (51/0); the old binary fails those 4 checks and plans a push of #7 (47/4). The verifiers' scripts (P1-P4, W1-W6, V0-V10) hold everything except the live-like shapes V0 and V4-V4c, which still read. A live fetch of the dashboard and the open pull requests gave byte-identical snapshot output from the old and the new binary, with nothing on standard error. iterations and wall_min are estimates.
